name: Logitech G903 LIGHTSPEED

notes: 67-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface of a real Logitech G903 LIGHTSPEED, from a libinput record of the device on Linux: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/libinput/libinput/uploads/bd8f0f17b047f4fe2093ff26b3d55804/record_logitech_g903_good.yml. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
